# PTD Fitness — Personal Trainers Dubai & Abu Dhabi

Mobile personal training company operating in Dubai and Abu Dhabi since 2012.

- Money site (booking and current pricing): https://www.personaltrainersdubai.com
- Resources hub (this site): https://resources.personaltrainersdubai.com
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/971506217146
- Email: milos@personaltrainersdubai.com

## What PTD does

- 1-on-1 personal training delivered at client's home, villa, apartment building gym, office, or hotel gym
- Structured 12-week body transformation programmes (men's and women's tracks)
- Nutrition coaching alongside training
- Female trainers available on request
- 3D body composition scanning (STYKU) at select Dubai locations where available
- AI-assisted coaching tools available to programme clients

## Service areas

Dubai: Dubai Marina, Palm Jumeirah, Downtown Dubai, DIFC, Business Bay, JBR, Emirates Hills, Jumeirah Golf Estates, Arabian Ranches, Dubai Hills Estate, Jumeirah, JLT.

Abu Dhabi: Saadiyat Island, Yas Island, Al Reem Island, Abu Dhabi Corniche.

## Pricing range

289 to 440 AED per session before 5% VAT, depending on package length. 8-session starter at 440 AED/session; 144-session annual commitment at 289 AED/session. Every package includes the trainer travelling to the client's location, all equipment, programming, nutrition guidance, and WhatsApp support between sessions.

## Founder

Milos Vukovic — international karate competitor, Master's degree in Sports and Physical Education. Founded PTD Fitness in Dubai in 2012.

## Track record

11,732+ documented client engagements since 2012. 600+ Google reviews at a 4.9-star average (verify live count at https://g.page/ptd-fitness).

## What this resource hub is

Public research and FAQ pages for prospective clients comparing personal training options in the UAE. Editorial pages only. For booking, current pricing, trainer profiles, and programme details, visit the money site.

## Accuracy note

Prices, trainer availability, locations, and package details can change. For the latest information, contact PTD Fitness directly via the money site or WhatsApp.
